meta.description: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK. Official Meta API.

copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 它把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/,追加注册 import、安装依赖 @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0,并跑构建和注册测试,再引导你填写 Meta 凭据写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Meta 官方 WhatsApp Business Cloud API 通道,或升级此前以 whatsapp 键注册的旧安装时触发。

say.text: 帮我接上 WhatsApp Cloud API 通道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑测试

say.text: WhatsApp 的 Phone Number ID 和访问令牌填哪?
say.note: 会依次提示填入四项凭据

say.text: 升级旧的 whatsapp 适配器安装

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, appends the registration import, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0, runs the build and registration test, and prompts for the Meta credentials saved to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel, or upgrade an older install that registered the bare whatsapp key.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud API channel for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs tests

say_en.text: Where do I put the Phone Number ID and access token?
say_en.note: Prompts for the four Meta credentials

say_en.text: Upgrade my old whatsapp adapter install
say_en.note: Moves to the whatsapp-cloud instance and webhook route
